Tertia opinio sic confutatur: Afferere mundum
frequenter genitum, & frequeter corruptum, per-
inde est atq; si dicas, mundum quidem semper eun-

surdum: igitur & illud peræque absurdum habebi-
tur. Ergo opiniones illæ explodi debent.
Ut autem certa habeatur de propositâ quæsti-
one sententia, primùm quarundam vocum, videlicet
Ingeniti & Geniti, item Incorruptibilis & Corru-
ptibilis, varia acceptio explicanda est, postea quid
sentire deceat definiemus.

page.notes: The left margin marks "3.", "1." and "2." are small section numbers; the mark beside "Tertia" may be a symbol and is read as 3. Text is set in italic; the headline "Quot modis dicitur ingenitum?" is roman. The last line "uerò" stands alone at the right and is treated as the catchword. Printed u/v spelling was normalised as instructed (iuuene to iuvene, Vt to Ut, uaria to varia). No other doubtful readings.
